verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI is an open-source, self-hostable library (Docker/FastAPI) with no forced API keys or paywalls, so there is no vendor-held data to leave behind. Its outputs are open formats: Markdown, including CLI `-o markdown`, and structured JSON via schemas. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of data export/portability (e.g., exporting saved browser profiles, session or crawl state), and independent hands-on corroboration of a lock-in-free exit.
